newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH CLUB SACK PLAYER FOR "FLASHING".
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH CLUB SACK PLAYER FOR "FLASHING".

text.p: Dutch second division side Eindhoven have fired midfielder Patrick Deckers for dropping his shorts and "flashing" at the crowd.
Deckers performed his impromptu striptease after he was shown the red card and booed by fans in a league match against Helmond Sport on Monday.
Eindhoven said on Thursday his behaviour was unacceptable. "Showing ones' genitals in public is forbidden by law...and is seen as disturbing public order," the club said.
